$comment: T-903 rights matrix. This is a project risk-control registry, not legal advice. Checked 2026-08-31.
policy_default: If rights are unclear, use a neutral original replacement and keep the reference out of production assets.

brussels_movable_heritage.limitations: Inventory metadata identifies works and creators; it is not a production-asset reproduction licence.

open_data_logo_rule.summary: The Open Data terms contain a specific graphical charter for Producer name, line colours and logos in products reusing the Information. This is not treated as a general licence for decorative branding, vehicle livery, station signage or marketing endorsement.
implementation: Keep Open Data attribution/compliance presentation logically separate from world assets and livery.
If the Open Data licence requires a Producer logo in a data-reuse interface/communication, use only the exact unmodified asset and scope allowed by that licence after legal/compliance review.
Do not infer permission for STIB logo placement on trains, station meshes, splash screens or store marketing from the Open Data clause.

rules: No third-party binary/reference material enters production asset directories without an explicit compatible licence or written permission reference.
Public availability is not a licence.
GitHub repositories without an explicit compatible licence are reference_only.
Screenshots, maps, plans and photographs used for research are not committed as production assets merely because they are publicly viewable.
Facts may be extracted with provenance; copyrighted expression is not copied into textures, meshes, audio or UI.
When rights are unclear, choose a neutral original replacement and record the unresolved rights item here.
